acts: AIFC Data Protection Regulations and Rules

en.title: s.16-2(7) points to 'measures referred to in section 24-1(1) and 24-1(2)'; s.24-1 contains no measures
en.summary: Section 16-2(7): adherence by a Processor or Sub-processor to an approved certification mechanism "may demonstrate the sufficiency of the measures referred to in section 24-1(1) and 24-1(2)". Section 24-1(1) allows a certification scheme to be established; section 24-1(2) says certification does not relieve responsibility. None of them refers to any measures. The assurances and measures of processors and sub-processors are dealt with in section 16-2(1), (2) and (3).
en.correction: Please state which measures section 16-2(7) refers to (for example those in section 16-2(1) and (2), or in section 16-2(1) and (3)) and correct the reference to section 24-1(1) and (2) accordingly.

quotes.text: may demonstrate the sufficiency of the measures referred to in section 24-1(1) and 24-1(2).

quotes.source: AIFC DATA PROTECTION REGULATIONS (with amendments as of 1 April 2025)
quotes.text: A certification scheme may be established for the purposes of enabling a Data Controller or Data Processor to demonstrate compliance with these Regulations.

quotes.source: AIFC DATA PROTECTION REGULATIONS (with amendments as of 1 April 2025)
quotes.text: Any certification achieved by a Data Controller or Data Processor does not relieve it of any responsibility for compliance with these Regulations.

quotes.source: AIFC DATA PROTECTION REGULATIONS (with amendments as of 1 April 2025)
quotes.text: A Controller must only enter into agreements with Processors that provide sufficient assurances to implement appropriate technical and organisational measures
